game.name: Pest Smash
dev.tip_big: Activate Big Hammer now: hit range ×2 and one-shot any pest (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_dual: Activate Dual Hammers now: off-hand hammer adds a second hit point (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_spray: Activate Insect Spray now: sprayed pests turn on their kin (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_vacuum: Activate Vacuum now: sucks up all pests in a wide area (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_double: Activate Double Score now: kill points ×2 (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_cat: Spawn a Robot Cat now: auto-hunts the nearest pest
dev.tip_kill_all: Clear the screen: all pests die at once with normal scoring (drops included)
dev.tip_speed: Pest speed multiplier (applies to newly spawned pests)
dev.tip_spawn: Spawn interval multiplier (lower = pests spawn faster)
dev.tip_drop: Power-up drop rate (chance a killed pest drops a power-up)
